answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Only 200 slots open each epoch; claiming one burns a 40-unit deposit, forfeited if the work is dropped or fails audit. A forger wanting 1,000 fake slots must burn 40,000 units up front, and a ferrous-stamped audit log, reviewed at a summit of verifiers, exposes repeat forgeries. Honest agents pay once, keep their slot, and earn a jade seal for the next slot, so their reward is not diluted by fakes.
